customer_persona: Karan Patel is a working professional who is anxious and frustrated after discovering a duplicate charge on his bank statement for an online appliance order.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase customer care. Please note this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my name is Karan Patel. I am extremely annoyed right now. I bought a kettle from your website yesterday and my bank statement shows that the amount was debited twice!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your concern, Mr. Patel, and I can certainly check into this for you. To ensure your account security, may I please have your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the Order ID is ORD-19287 and the last four digits of my phone number are 9423.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for verifying those details, Mr. Patel. Please give me a moment while I pull up the billing records in our system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, please check. I was charged eight hundred and ninety-nine rupees twice for the Prestige Electric Kettle.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see the details here. Just to confirm that I have understood correctly, you ordered the Prestige Electric Kettle 1.5L for Rs 899, but during the transaction your bank account experienced a duplicate deduction of Rs 899, and you want to verify the status of the reversal. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is exactly what happened. I need to know where the extra money went.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand how stressful duplicate charges can be, Mr. Patel, and I am truly sorry for the trouble this has caused you today. You have reached the right person, and I will personally make sure this is resolved for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, I appreciate that. What does the system show?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our payment gateway logs confirm that due to a network timeout during the checkout attempt, a secondary charge was captured. As per our billing policy, duplicate deductions are flagged by automated reconciliation and the full refund of Rs 899 is released back to the source payment method within 24 hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, and when will the money actually reflect in my bank account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Standard banking settlement timelines take 5 to 7 business days for the funds to reflect in your statement, although UPI transactions typically credit back within 24 to 48 hours depending on your bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, that is fair enough. Do I need to fill out any form or raise a ticket?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No form is required. I have already flagged the duplicate transaction in our portal, and your refund authorization is logged under service request reference SR-74102.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That sounds good. I have noted down the reference number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To recap, we have verified the duplicate payment of Rs 899 for your Prestige Electric Kettle under Order ID ORD-19287. The reversal has been processed under reference SR-74102 and will reflect in your account within 5 to 7 business days. Aside from this, is there anything else I can help you with today, Mr. Patel?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was my only concern. You have explained everything clearly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase. We appreciate your patience and hope you have a great day ahead!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks Rohan, you too. Goodbye.

verification_notes: Passed: The agent adhered to all required protocols: call recording disclosure was provided in turn 1, authentication with both Order ID and last 4 digits of the phone number was completed prior to accessing details, and no out-of-policy refund promises were made.
